What Your Job Will Be Like We are seeking a Program Chief Engineer (PCE) for the W87-1 to serve as the senior technical leader for a highly visible, mission-critical modernization program. In this role, you will report to the Center 2300 Director and partner with senior managers, managers, and staff as the Sandia technical lead integrating all aspects of the program, providing enterprise-level technical leadership and authoritative guidance across multiple disciplines and organizations As the W87-1 PCE, you will shape technical direction for the program by leading system integration, design optimization, qualification strategy, anomaly resolution, and complex technical trades across the Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE). Provide authoritative technical leadership for the W87-1 system, supported by the W87-1 Core Team, by defining and evaluating technical approaches that guide system decisions within program constraints. Evaluate and disposition technical change requests using sound engineering judgment and consideration of technical risk, cost, schedule, and mission impact. Lead system integration, design optimization, and development of design themes, with emphasis on innovative approaches that improve technical performance and long-term mission capability. Systems integration will include engaging production agencies to create product realization solutions that maintain design intent and are supported by solid technical basis. Establish and maintain a defensible qualification basis by integrating modeling, simulation, testing, and other technical evidence to resolve complex multidisciplinary questions. Communicate key technical concerns, risks, and alternative technical paths to Sandia executive leadership to support enterprise-level decision-making, ensuring that critical issues such as inadequate technical definition, unclear or TBD requirements, and single-point technical failures are fully understood. Assure technical rigor and documentation quality for system-level product realization documents, including signature approval on key system-level paperwork such as CD, ME, BB, PQ, RQs, and NS, while contributing to technical standards, practices, and lessons learned that benefit future efforts. Act as SNL lead for technical integration and optimization with LLNL, including advisement and technical authority for system interface documentation such as IDs and external ICDs, ensuring consistency across technical domains and partner organizations. Represent Sandia technical equities within the POG and provide technical briefings as needed to do so. Provide technical coordination and engagement with POG, POG subteams, and the NNSA Project Team in coordination with program senior managers, while contributing to cross-program technical alignment. Serve as the lead interface for major peer and technical reviews across the program, partnering with DCEs to identify appropriate review areas, execute and document the program's peer review plan, and use outcomes to advance technical understanding and inform future strategy. Identify and mentor next-generation technical leaders in system integration to strengthen institutional capability. Engage in the review and support of other ND system integration activities, as needed, in coordination with the 2300 Director and Chief Engineer Network. Champion digital engineering, model-based systems engineering, and advanced manufacturing initiatives, including development and insertion of innovative methods that improve technical decision-making and future program execution within program constraints. Lead cybersecurity implementation and assurance, including rigor in technical data packages with DoD, aligned with DoD and NNSA requirements to ensure technical solutions are robust, integrated, and sustainable across the system lifecycle. Provide technical briefings to internal and external stakeholders, including NDEAB, the Lab Director, Congressional staff, and DoD, representing Sandia as a recognized technical expert in complex modernization. The selected candidate will lead teams staffed by the W87-1 management team and oversee execution of the program's system design architecture, stewardship of the Material Requirements Schedule (MRS), and leadership of the Systems Core team. Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite. This position also requires travel between locations approximately 25% of the time. Salary Range $163,700 - $278,000 Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential. Qualifications We Require Master's or PhD in a relevant STEM discipline and 10 or more years of relevant ND experience. Direct technical experience in modernization programs for nuclear weapons systems, subsystems, surveillance, production, and/or components. Active DOE Q clearance or equivalent with the ability to obtain additional clearances as required. Applicants must submit a minimum of three and a maximum of five professional references. Qualifications We Desire A broad and established network within Sandia's ND weapons product realization and science and technology communities. Broad understanding of the Sandia ND mission and Sandia's interfaces and responsibilities within the NNSA and the Nuclear Security Enterprise (NSE), particularly LLNL, KCNSC, and PX. Direct experience in system-level technical leadership of modernization programs across multiple lifecycle phases. Experience conceiving, developing, and leading cross-organizational technical programs, projects, and teams. Prior or existing working relationships with NNSA and with DoD elements supporting modernization programs. Experience leading system integration efforts, resolving complex multidisciplinary technical issues, and making risk-informed technical trade decisions within programmatic constraints. Experience establishing or evaluating qualification strategies and balanced technical bases using modeling, simulation, testing, and other technical evidence. Experience with digital engineering, model-based systems engineering, and/or advanced manufacturing approaches. Experience leading or contributing to major technical or peer review activities. Outstanding organizational and briefing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences including senior customers, external partners, and SNL executive leadership. About Our Team The ND Weapon System Modernization Center performs systems engineering and leadership for the modernization of multiple nuclear weapon systems. Focus of the center is on product realization beginning in Phase 2/6.2, through full scale engineering, pre-production, and transition into full scale production (Phase 6/6.6). In all phases, assuring the safety, security, and reliability of weapons throughout their anticipated life cycle and the development of the supporting technical basis are an essential part of Center activities. In partnership with Centers 8200 and 2200, the center leads the Laboratories efforts to develop integrated engineering solutions to maintain weapon system required military effectiveness and reliability while seeking improvements in safety and security where possible within programmatic constraints. The current focus of this organization is to deliver on time and within budget the W87-1 and W93. Applicants for employment need to be able to maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted. Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment. EEO All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law. review_candidates.description: Référence 2323/MTL/2310 Date de démarrage Au plus vite Localisation du poste 100% télétravail Durée Permanent Description Nous recherchons un Analyste en cybersécurité-volet opérationnel afin de rejoindre notre équipe de conseillers du bureau de Québec ou de Montréal dans le cadre d'un poste permanent. Ce poste est en mode télétravail. Agissant à titre de conseiller / consultant de Chrome Technologies, le candidat interviendra auprès de nos clients dans la réalisation des projets qu'ils nous ont confiés. Tâches Le mandat consiste à assurer la sécurité des opérations technologiques dans le cadre du dossier SIFA. La personne agit à titre d'experte en cybersécurité opérationnelle et contribue à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la réduction des risques de sécurité liés aux environnements technologiques. Elle participe notamment aux analyses et aux recommandations en matière de sécurité, à la prévention et à la détection des menaces, à la coordination des événements et incidents de sécurité ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue des pratiques, processus et mécanismes de sécurité. Elle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes responsables de SIFA, les équipes technologiques et les intervenants en sécurité afin d'assurer une prise en charge cohérente et efficace des enjeux de cybersécurité, tout en tenant compte des orientations en matière de souveraineté numérique, de protection des données et de résilience des opérations. La personne titulaire du mandat sera notamment appelée à : Assurer la sécurité des opérations technologiques dans une perspective de souveraineté numérique, en contribuant à la protection des données, à la maîtrise des risques liés aux dépendances technologiques et à l'application de mesures de sécurité adaptées au contexte. Assurer une vigie continue des menaces, vulnérabilités et risques susceptibles d'affecter les opérations de SIFA et formuler des recommandations afin de soutenir la prise de décision. Évaluer les impacts des vulnérabilités connues sur les infrastructures et composantes technologiques utilisées et maintenir une connaissance à jour des actifs concernés. Conseiller les équipes responsables de SIFA sur les exigences et considérations de sécurité liées au développement, à l'architecture technologique, à l'exploitation et à la planification des projets. Collaborer au processus de gestion des changements en évaluant les risques et les impacts potentiels sur la sécurité des opérations. Contribuer aux analyses de risques en sécurité de l'information, identifier les menaces et vulnérabilités et recommander les mesures de mitigation ou d'atténuation appropriées. Participer à l'élaboration, à la mise à jour et à l'évolution des plans et procédures de réponse aux incidents de sécurité, incluant les mécanismes d'escalade et de coordination requis. Configurer, maintenir et optimiser les outils de surveillance de sécurité, effectuer la surveillance quotidienne des environnements et procéder à l'analyse des journaux et événements lorsque requis. Réaliser certaines activités opérationnelles de sécurité, notamment celles liées à la gestion des privilèges élevés, des accès et des demandes de décloisonnement. Coordonner les activités lors d'événements ou d'incidents de sécurité, participer aux cellules de crise et assurer le suivi des mesures de confinement, de correction et de remédiation. Produire et maintenir la documentation requise, notamment les rapports d'incidents, analyses de causes, constats post-incident et registres des événements de sécurité. Assurer le suivi des recommandations et mesures correctives découlant des incidents, vulnérabilités et analyses de risques. Participer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques et procédures de cybersécurité opérationnelle ainsi qu'à l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mécanismes de suivi et de la qualité des services de sécurité.
